crosscutting.coordinates: API and GeoJSON tuples remain longitude,latitude; native maps use latitude,longitude objects. Preserve route segments and all stop memberships.
crosscutting.authentication: Public reads omit bearer credentials. Owner reads, pending places, server saves, reports and contribution writes explicitly use the current bearer session. Studio new-route submission can be anonymous; linked edits cannot.
crosscutting.lifecycle: Abort screen-owned pagination, search, geocoding and location requests on blur, background and parameter changes. Ignore responses from an older query or account. Retain already loaded pages when a later page fails.
crosscutting.writes: No automated contribution, report, save, photo or moderation writes against production. Validate request and acknowledgement shapes with isolated fixtures or a test backend. Never infer a successful save from a redirect or an absent response ID.
crosscutting.nativeMaps: Apple Maps exposes real geographic map taps and camera changes. Native Studio edits select a vertex then tap its replacement, or confirm the actual camera center. Marker drag/long press are deliberately adapted. Place and hotel clusters use separate Supercluster indexes with source radius25/maxZoom10 and viewport-aware MapKit zoom conversion.
crosscutting.existingBaseline: Keep TransitScreen, TransitCityScreen, PlacesScreen, PlaceScreen and SavedScreen exports. Device-local saved snapshots remain separate from account-synchronized saves, with explicit labels. Existing iPad/Duo baseline screenshots do not verify these new flows.
